name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Standard Terms)
description: Standard terms for mutual confidentiality and non-disclosure of proprietary information between parties.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement Cover Page
description: Cover page template for specifying parties, purpose, effective date, and key terms for the Mutual NDA.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Standard terms for providing and consuming cloud-based software-as-a-service (SaaS) products.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Agreement allowing early-access design partners to test and provide feedback on products in development.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Agreement defining availability targets, uptime calculation, maintenance windows, and technical support response times.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Framework agreement for professional services, statements of work (SOWs), deliverables, and acceptance criteria.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Data protection agreement governing personal data processing, roles, sub-processors, and security measures in compliance with GDPR and privacy laws.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Standard software license agreement governing installation, usage, permitted uses, and intellectual property rights.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Agreement defining commercial cooperation, co-marketing, revenue sharing, and obligations between business partners.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: HIPAA-compliant agreement governing the handling, safeguarding, and permitted disclosure of Protected Health Information (PHI).

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Agreement governing time-limited pilot evaluations, trial deployments, and proof-of-concept testing of products or services.

name: AI Addendum
description: Addendum governing the use of artificial intelligence services, handling of customer inputs/outputs, model training restrictions, and IP protections.
